file_01.title: Opening the File Door
file_01.prompt: Which function is used in Python to open a file?
file_01.explanation: The open() function is like the key that unlocks the door to a diary or file on the computer!

file_03.explanation: Using "with open" is awesome because it closes the file automatically when we finish, preventing it from getting locked!

file_04.title: The Line Counter
file_04.prompt: Create a function `contar_linhas(texto_multilinhas)` that simulates the content of a file by splitting the text into lines (`.splitlines()`) and returning the total number of lines!
file_04.explanation: splitlines() splits a huge text into a list of individual lines, and len() counts how many lines exist!
